about_the_game:
Background

Your father, the district governor, used a little bit of tactics to train you to become the manager of District 21 of the Black Stone Mining Cave, and set a small goal for you: to make a hundred million dollars. You need to work hard to run District 21 and find ways to earn money from adventurers.

About

Journey of Harvest is a top-down simulation game that combines planting, automation, adventure and tower defence combat elements. The game revolves around the ‘adventure gathering - base processing - commodity selling’ mode. Players go on adventures in mines, collect all kinds of resources, return to the base to process and sell them, and challenge the ultimate small goals.

Adventure Gathering - Turns & Tower Defence & Combos

Players need to protect the mining machines from enemy attacks by building walls, defensive turrets, and defences before the start of each turn, while weapons are loaded and ready to meet the enemies attacking from all sides.

As you level up, you will unlock more types of turrets, and players can freely combine them and fuse their special attributes.

Simplify game play with a quick setup interface.

Base processing-Automation & magic props

In order to reach the small goal of earning a quick billion, players can process the resources obtained from adventure gathering, and they can make their value increase. Based on this principle, assembling an automated production line and waiting some time can create a lot of items. What? Don't want to wait too long? Just take a quick nap in the game and wait for the next day.

As the level rises, you will find more and more magical props, these props can help you solve a lot of trouble, such as letting plants grow quickly, letting time in the area flow quickly or time stops ...... make good use of them, so that you get twice the result with half the effort.

Commodity Trafficking - Commodities & Quotations

As you level up, there will be more and more commodities that can be developed, and you can reap higher profits by choosing the right time to sell these commodities.

Adventurers - Hire & Fight

If you're feeling a touch tired of the whole resource gathering thing, you can hire a squad of adventurers to head out to the mines to gather, and while the gathering quests are perilous, we've passed some policies to confiscate the funds of dead adventurers

Base - Construction & Development

Players can build large, exclusive rooms on the surface to research technology, develop goods, produce equipment and machines, as well as grow various types of crops.

Deploy various equipment, robotic arms, and conveyor belts to automate production. Players can also build highly efficient facilities underground to produce various types of basic and processed resources.
